newsitem.title: USA: Petrolite sets July 1 acquisition vote.
newsitem.headline: Petrolite sets July 1 acquisition vote.

text.p: Petrolite Corp, a specialty chemicals maker, on Monday said it scheduled its annual shareholders meeting for July 1 in Chesterfield, Missouri.
At the meeting, shareholders will vote on Petrolite's pending acquisition by Baker Hughes Inc.
If approved, the deal is expected to close the following day, Petrolite said.

In February, the companies announced the planned acquisition of Petrolite in a stock swap valued at about $693 million. The exact exchange ratio will be based on the average stock market price of Baker Hughes shares in 10 days before the closing, the companies said.
